# kion_idms (Resource)

Manages a Kion Idms.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_idms" "example" {
  # Required
  idms_type_id        = 1
  name                = "example"
  password_expiration = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `idms_type_id` (Number) ID of the IDMS type in the application. 1 is Internal Directory, 2 is
Active Directory, 3 is SAML.
- `name` (String) Name of the IDMS in the application.
- `password_expiration` (Number) Number of days until a password reset dialog displays on login.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) IDMS ID.
